svg.title: GetCovered blank wireframe (A4)
svg.desc: Draw your layout on this A4 page (210 x 297 mm). Put field names in curly braces, for example {course.code}. Draw the logo as a dashed rectangle containing {logo}. Delete this note and the legend before you send it.

g.text: {field.name} = where that field's text goes (list of names in the brief)
dashed box with {logo} = the logo; its height sets the size
plain words you write (e.g. "Submitted to:") are copied as they are
blue dashed box = default margin; ignored, margins are user-adjustable
add notes like "20px bold uppercase" next to any text to set its style
